meanings.en: happening often or existing in many places; not unusual
meanings.exampleEn: Mobile phones are now commonplace in every household.
meanings.exampleTr: Cep telefonları artık her evde sıradan bir şey.

meanings.en: a remark or statement that is ordinary and not interesting
meanings.exampleEn: His speech was full of commonplaces about hard work.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşması, çok çalışmaya dair klişelerle doluydu.

meanings.en: the state of not being prepared for something
meanings.exampleEn: The report exposed the country's unreadiness for a major flood.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, ülkenin büyük bir sel karşısındaki hazırlıksızlığını ortaya koydu.

meanings.en: the quality of trying to appear more important or better than you really are
meanings.exampleEn: The film was criticized for its pretentiousness and empty style.
meanings.exampleTr: Film, gösterişçiliği ve içi boş üslubu nedeniyle eleştirildi.

meanings.en: unable to protect yourself from attack or harm
meanings.exampleEn: The wounded soldier was left defenseless on the battlefield.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaralı asker savaş alanında savunmasız bırakıldı.

meanings.en: not recognized, admitted, or given credit
meanings.exampleEn: Her contribution to the project went unacknowledged for years.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeye katkısı yıllarca takdir edilmedi.

meanings.en: the quality of not being able to be trusted or relied on
meanings.exampleEn: The team's undependability cost them several important clients.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekibin güvenilmezliği, onlara birkaç önemli müşteriye mal oldu.

meanings.tr: özür dilemeyen, yaptığından pişman olmayan, dik duran
meanings.en: not feeling or showing regret for something you have done or believe
meanings.exampleEn: She was completely unapologetic about her strong opinions.
meanings.exampleTr: Sert görüşlerinden dolayı hiç özür dilemedi, dik durdu.

meanings.en: not making you feel satisfied or happy
meanings.exampleEn: He quit his well-paid but unfulfilling job to start over.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi maaşlı ama tatmin etmeyen işinden ayrılıp sıfırdan başladı.

meanings.tr: akademik olmayan, ders çalışmaya yatkın olmayan
meanings.en: not academic; not interested in or good at studying
meanings.exampleEn: He was a practical, rather unacademic boy who loved fixing engines.
meanings.exampleTr: Motor tamir etmeyi seven, pratik ve akademik olmayan bir çocuktu.

meanings.en: practical and determined; making decisions based on facts rather than emotions
meanings.exampleEn: We need a hardheaded assessment of the risks before investing.
meanings.exampleTr: Yatırım yapmadan önce risklerin gerçekçi bir değerlendirmesine ihtiyacımız var.

meanings.en: stubborn and unwilling to change your mind
meanings.exampleEn: He was too hardheaded to admit he was wrong.
meanings.exampleTr: Yanıldığını kabul edemeyecek kadar dik kafalıydı.

meanings.tr: duygusuz, olduğu gibi, ölçülü ve soğukkanlı
meanings.en: showing no emotion; dealing with things in a practical way
meanings.exampleEn: She described the accident in a calm, matter-of-fact voice.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazayı sakin, duygusuz bir sesle anlattı.

meanings.en: not clearly described, stated, or limited
meanings.exampleEn: His exact role in the company remains undefined.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketteki tam rolü hâlâ belirsiz.

meanings.en: not said or expressed directly
meanings.exampleEn: There was an unstated assumption that she would pay.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun ödeyeceğine dair dile getirilmemiş bir varsayım vardı.

meanings.en: not spoken aloud, although thought of or felt
meanings.exampleEn: Some things are better left unsaid.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı şeyler söylenmeden bırakılsa daha iyidir.

meanings.en: the state of shaking or being unsteady, weak, or uncertain
meanings.exampleEn: The shakiness of his hands made it hard to write.
meanings.exampleTr: Ellerinin titrekliği yazı yazmasını zorlaştırıyordu.

meanings.en: the quality of moving unsteadily from side to side; instability
meanings.exampleEn: The wobbliness of the old table made everyone nervous.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski masanın sallantısı herkesi tedirgin etti.

meanings.en: to pay money regularly to receive a service or publication
meanings.exampleEn: I subscribe to several online magazines.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç çevrimiçi dergiye abone oluyorum.

meanings.en: to agree with or support an opinion, theory, or idea
meanings.exampleEn: I don't subscribe to the view that money brings happiness.
meanings.exampleTr: Paranın mutluluk getirdiği görüşünü benimsemiyorum.

meanings.en: not based on facts or good reasons
meanings.exampleEn: The company dismissed the rumors as completely baseless.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, söylentileri tamamen asılsız olarak reddetti.

meanings.en: supported or proved by evidence
meanings.exampleEn: His claims were fully substantiated by the documents.
meanings.exampleTr: İddiaları belgelerle tamamen kanıtlandı.

meanings.en: not aware of possible dangers or problems
meanings.exampleEn: Scammers often target unwary tourists.
meanings.exampleTr: Dolandırıcılar genellikle tedbirsiz turistleri hedef alır.

meanings.en: impossible to justify, excuse, or defend
meanings.exampleEn: Their treatment of the workers was morally indefensible.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçilere yaptıkları muamele ahlaki olarak savunulamazdı.

meanings.en: able to be defended against attack or criticism; reasonable
meanings.exampleEn: His argument is no longer tenable in light of the new evidence.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni kanıtlar ışığında argümanı artık savunulabilir değil.

meanings.en: able to be justified or protected against attack
meanings.exampleEn: The decision is defensible on both legal and moral grounds.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar, hem hukuki hem ahlaki açıdan savunulabilir.

meanings.en: not yet tested, used, or attempted
meanings.exampleEn: The new method is promising but as yet untried.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yöntem umut verici ama henüz denenmemiş.

meanings.en: impossible to harm, damage, or defeat
meanings.exampleEn: No fortress is truly invulnerable to attack.
meanings.exampleTr: Hiçbir kale saldırıya karşı gerçekten dokunulmaz değildir.

meanings.en: impossible to attack, question, or defeat
meanings.exampleEn: The team built up an unassailable lead by half-time.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım devre arasına kadar karşı konulamaz bir üstünlük kurdu.

meanings.tr: distopik, karanlık bir gelecek tasviri olan
meanings.en: relating to an imagined future society where life is very bad or frightening
meanings.exampleEn: The novel paints a dystopian world ruled by machines.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman, makinelerin yönettiği distopik bir dünya çiziyor.

meanings.en: in a brave and admirable way
meanings.exampleEn: The firefighters fought the blaze heroically.
meanings.exampleTr: İtfaiyeciler yangınla kahramanca mücadele etti.

meanings.en: extremely large size or extent
meanings.exampleEn: We were awed by the immensity of the ocean.
meanings.exampleTr: Okyanusun uçsuz bucaksızlığı bizi hayrete düşürdü.

meanings.en: the very great size, seriousness, or extent of something bad
meanings.exampleEn: The enormity of the disaster slowly sank in.
meanings.exampleTr: Felaketin vahameti yavaş yavaş anlaşıldı.

meanings.en: a very serious crime or act of great wickedness
meanings.exampleEn: The enormities of the war were never forgotten.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaşın büyük kötülükleri hiç unutulmadı.

meanings.en: the quality of being small in size or amount
meanings.exampleEn: The smallness of the room made it feel cramped.
meanings.exampleTr: Odanın küçüklüğü onu sıkışık hissettiriyordu.

meanings.tr: seyyar satıcılık; (kötü bir şeyi) yayma, pazarlama
meanings.en: the act of selling goods, especially illegal ones or by going from place to place; promoting ideas
meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for peddling drugs near the school.
meanings.exampleTr: Okulun yakınında uyuşturucu satmaktan tutuklandı.

meanings.en: abbreviation of 'versus'; used to show that two teams or ideas are against each other
meanings.exampleEn: Tonight's match is Brazil vs Argentina.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu geceki maç Brezilya'ya karşı Arjantin.

meanings.en: the state of paying careful attention in order to notice danger or problems
meanings.exampleEn: The guard kept a constant watchfulness over the entrance.
meanings.exampleTr: Nöbetçi girişi sürekli bir tetiklikle gözledi.

meanings.en: very brave or showing great courage
meanings.exampleEn: The rescue was a heroic effort by the whole crew.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurtarma, tüm ekibin kahramanca bir çabasıydı.

meanings.en: a small poisonous snake found in Europe and other regions
meanings.exampleEn: We spotted an adder sunning itself on the path.
meanings.exampleTr: Patikada güneşlenen bir engerek gördük.

meanings.en: the firing of several guns at the same time in a battle or as a signal
meanings.exampleEn: The ships fired a salvo to mark the ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Gemiler töreni işaretlemek için yaylım ateşi açtı.

meanings.tr: (eleştiri, söz vb.) ani ve yoğun saldırı
meanings.en: a sudden series of aggressive statements or actions
meanings.exampleEn: She opened with a salvo of criticism against the government.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümete karşı bir dizi sert eleştiriyle söze başladı.

meanings.en: always wanting more; impossible to satisfy
meanings.exampleEn: She has an insatiable appetite for gossip.
meanings.exampleTr: Dedikoduya karşı doyumsuz bir iştahı var.

meanings.en: a complete and embarrassing failure
meanings.exampleEn: The launch event turned into a total fiasco.
meanings.exampleTr: Lansman etkinliği tam bir fiyaskoya dönüştü.

meanings.en: lazy and worthless; having no useful qualities
meanings.exampleEn: His good-for-nothing brother never held a job.
meanings.exampleTr: İşe yaramaz kardeşi hiçbir işte tutunamadı.

meanings.en: to be careful of something dangerous
meanings.exampleEn: Beware of the dog when you enter the yard.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahçeye girerken köpeğe dikkat et.

meanings.tr: (birine) aniden ve rahatsız edici şekilde yaklaşıp konuşmak, yolunu kesmek
meanings.en: to approach and speak to someone in an aggressive or unwelcome way
meanings.exampleEn: A stranger accosted me on the street asking for money.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir yabancı sokakta yolumu kesip para istedi.

meanings.en: to stop something or someone that is moving from one place to another
meanings.exampleEn: Police intercepted the shipment before it reached the border.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis, sevkiyatı sınıra ulaşmadan ele geçirdi.

meanings.tr: otoriter lider, güç kullanarak yöneten kişi
meanings.en: a leader who rules a country using force and threats
meanings.exampleEn: The country was ruled for decades by a military strongman.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke onlarca yıl askeri bir otoriter lider tarafından yönetildi.

meanings.tr: pehlivan, güç gösterisi yapan güçlü adam
meanings.en: a man who performs feats of physical strength as entertainment
meanings.exampleEn: The circus strongman lifted the heavy barbell with ease.
meanings.exampleTr: Sirk pehlivanı ağır halteri kolayca kaldırdı.
